properties.site-address: Former Ripon Cathedral Choir School, Whitcliffe Lane, Ripon
properties.notes: Current planning application is for full planning permission, resolution to permit subject to completion of S106 Agreement, included as housing allocation in Publication Local Plan (submitted for examination in August 2018). Demolition of existing school buildings, conversion of building to form 12 apartments and erection of 105 dwellings (117 dwellings in total).
